_note: Peak-hour road slowdown by metro area. 'index' is the Travel Time Index: peak travel time divided by free-flow travel time, where free-flow is the overnight speed, which is what a router's no-traffic time is closest to. The index values are published; the circles that say where each metro area is are OUR assumption. See RESEARCH.md section 13.
source: Texas A&M Transportation Institute, Urban Mobility Report 2025 (2024 data), https://static.tti.tamu.edu/tti.tamu.edu/documents/mobility-report-2025.pdf

peak_hours_local.note: The report's own peak windows: 6 to 10 a.m. and 3 to 7 p.m. It publishes one index for both peaks, not one per hour.

outside_metro_note: FDOT's rural Planning Time Index is the same at the peak hour and across the day (1.12 and 1.12), so rural roads get no peak slowdown.
